fact: From n=λ+1>0 with λ∈ℤ and I={i∈ℤ:0≤i≤λ}, I has n elements (with the usual identification of a nonnegative integer and its natural-number cardinality).
justification: Here λ≥0. Writing λ=L for its corresponding natural number, enumerate I by 0,1,...,L. Each listed integer lies in I, every integer in I occurs, and different indices give different integers. Counting this list by induction gives L+1=n. This completes only the routine finite count implicit in S003, not a basis or structure theorem.

grounds.reason: Specifies that λ is an integer.
